entries.title: The first mate sees when a crewmate takes back its own question
entries.body: When a crewmate takes back a question it asked you, the first mate now sees that you pressed none of its buttons, beside anything the crewmate says about your answer. A crewmate's claim that you approved it can be caught before work goes ahead on it, and the task's record shows who ended each question.
entries.noPicture: The fix changes what the first mate knows about a crewmate's question and shows no different view.
